title: Open-source silicon access: open PDKs, open EDA flows and MPW aggregators (SKY130, GF180, IHP, Tiny Tapeout, ChipFoundry, Europractice) and their viability after Efabless
why_it_matters: Open PDKs are the only fully public view into PDK content and remove NDA/export barriers, but access depended on a single aggregator that shut down in 2025; relevant to start-ups, education and workforce.
questions: Who now runs open-PDK shuttles and at what price per design?
How many designs per year are taped out on open PDKs?
Are any open PDKs at production (non-preview) status?

title: Mask data preparation and computational lithography: OPC/ILT software, mask writers, who performs MDP, and data formats (OASIS.MASK, MALY, MEBES, P10)
why_it_matters: The post-tape-out data chain (OPC, fracture, job decks) is a compute-heavy, vendor-concentrated software market between EDA and mask making that no unit covers.
questions: Which vendors supply OPC/ILT and MDP software and what is the market size?
Who runs OPC at leading-edge foundries versus merchant mask shops?
How are mask-writer formats and SEMI P44/P45/P10 used today?
